name: Natsugami Mikoto
source:
[url=/c95192]Haruna[/url]'s mother.

She operates a candy store called Natsugami Company.

She is a gentle woman who embraces everyone with warmth. But she has a fiendish side to her as well.

[Translated from [url=https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/220/article/418175]Ci-en[/url]]
